## Experience

- **Full Stack Developer — Solkuu (GrabLocal)** (Jul 2025 – Jun 2026, Bangalore): Core team member on GrabLocal, a curated marketplace and seller operating system. Built the seller CRM (React/Next.js), backend services (Node.js/Express), a React Native seller app, and an Electron.js desktop app for automated receipt printing.
- **Software Developer — AffWorld Technology** (May 2024 – May 2025, Remote): Led a Real Estate CRM (React Native/Expo), a property rental platform with Stripe payments, and a subscription app with Razorpay; implemented auth and role-based access control.
- **MERN Stack Intern — Brototype** (Aug 2023 – Apr 2024, Bangalore): Built a microservices job portal with Docker/Kubernetes, WebRTC video calls, Socket.IO chat, RabbitMQ + gRPC, and an eCommerce platform with Razorpay.
